Data Analyst – Growth Analytics
Company: Kartly (e-commerce), Pune / Hybrid

About the role
We are looking for a Data Analyst to help our growth and marketing teams make better decisions with data.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau or Power BI to track funnel and retention KPIs
- Write complex SQL queries against our PostgreSQL and BigQuery warehouses
- Analyze A/B tests and experiments and communicate results to product and marketing stakeholders
- Automate recurring reports using Python (Pandas)
- Partner with data engineering to improve data quality and data modeling

Requirements
- 3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in e-commerce or retail
- Strong SQL and Python skills
- Experience with Tableau or Power BI
- Solid understanding of statistics and A/B testing
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field

Nice to have
- Experience with BigQuery or Snowflake
- Familiarity with dbt and Airflow
